We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our Engineering Team.

Proven experience in developing and deploying enterprise-grade AI systems.

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Demonstrated expertise in LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures,
OCR, and Agentic AI frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development practices. Strong experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).
Hands-on expertise in MLOps & DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, Ansible, Infrastructure-as-Code).

Comfortable working across cross-functional and distributed teams. Preferred / General Requirements

Familiarity with frontend integration frameworks (e.g., ReactJS) for AI-enabled applications.
A passion for innovation and staying current with emerging trends in Generative AI and Agentic systems.

Actively write clean, maintainable, and high-quality code for both the front-end (React, TypeScript) and back-end (Python, Nodejs).
